rule.message:
Requirements for ALL MLS BS Learners: Cumulative and prerequisite GPA must be ≥ 2.75 upon admission.
Students must comply with the Technical Standard (Essential Functions) requirements of the program.
Admitted students are required to pass a criminal background check and submit proof of immunizations required for University of Minnesota Academic Health Science students. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Students will work with their Academic Advisor on course sequencing and planning.
All students must have liberal education requirements completed by the end of the spring semester before beginning the Year 4 curriculum.
In accordance with Minnesota law, a criminal background check is required of each student before clinical courses. The program arranges this background check.
Students are placed in a variety of clinical settings during their clinical coursework which may be in Minnesota or surrounding states.
Students are required to submit an exit survey as a condition of completion of the program.
At least 32 upper division credits must be taken on the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
A sample plan is available. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
